items.prompt: Why use deque.popleft rather than list.pop(0) for each service turn?

options.text: A list would sort jobs automatically before removal.
options.why: A list does not sort on pop; shifting is the relevant cost.

options.text: A deque merges equal identifiers automatically.
options.why: Neither container supplies a keyed merge rule.

options.text: A deque eliminates the need to store unfinished jobs.
A list front removal shifts entries; deque.popleft does not.
options.why: Repeated shifts would add avoidable work beyond the number of service visits.

items.explanation: Repeated shifts would add avoidable work beyond the number of service visits.
